qaPairs.answer: My name is **Amit Jatthap**. I am an AI/ML Developer & Software Engineer pursuing MCA in AI/ML. I specialize in building practical AI systems, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and modern full-stack web applications.
I am based in **Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh, India**. I am open to remote opportunities as well as relocating for full-time software and AI developer roles.

questions: What college did you go to?
MCA kahan se kar rahe ho?
qaPairs.answer: I completed my **B.Sc. in Computer Science** from Devi Ahilya Vishwavidlayava (DAVV), Indore. Currently, I am pursuing my **MCA in AI & ML** from K.R. Mangalam University, Gurugram.

My core skills span:
• **AI/ML & GenAI**: Python, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, Agentic AI
• **Core CS**: Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, DBMS, Object-Oriented Programming
• **Data Analytics**: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI, Tableau
• **Full Stack & Web**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
• **Tools**: Git, GitHub, Docker, VS Code, Linux

I have built 3 major AI projects:
1. 🌿 **EcoMatch**: AI-Powered Waste Exchange Platform using 4 autonomous LangGraph agents and FastAPI.
2. 🧠 **ASIE**: Adaptive Skill Intelligence Engine for future skill forecasting using XGBoost, Prophet, spaCy NLP, and SHAP.
3. 🎙️ **AI Sales Voice Agent**: Hallucination-Controlled Conversational AI with real-time speech pipeline, catalog guardrails, and conversation memory.
I have solved **350+ Data Structures & Algorithms problems** on LeetCode with a contest rating of ~1,842. I regularly practice problem solving in C++ and Python.

My key certifications include:
• 🏆 **Power BI for Beginner** (Simplilearn, 2025)
• 🏆 **Machine Learning with Python** (IBM, 2025)
• 🏆 **Generative AI** (OutSkills, 2025)
• 🏆 **HackKrmu- Hackathon 5.0** (K.R. Mangalam University, 2026)
• 🏆 **Full Stack with AI Integration & Problem Solving** (Programming Pathshala, 2026)
